description: One approval request (or choice): pending, approved, denied, chosen or expired, a choice's options and the one chosen; once decided, who decided, when, in which role, how (credential kind, MCP relay), the phone proof when one was asked for, and the registry's signed statement. wait_seconds (0 to 20) holds the answer while it is pending. Any member of the room may read it. Agent JWT or developer key.

agent_jwt.description: Optional: the asking agent's JWT (getAgentToken), when this connection holds a developer key

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this many seconds while it is pending (0 to 20)

name: theprotocol_getChatApprovalStatus
title: Get Chat Approval Status
